description: Cheapen the LOW-RANK path's ORTHOGONALITY gate GEMM by exploiting the KNOWN block structure of V=[Vd,Vc] -- it is paid on ALL 5 low-rank shapes (3/4/8/10/12) so even a 1-2ms cut compounds. Current gate (_eigh_lowrank_safe): orth = ||_gram_3xtf32(V) - I||_1, a FULL n*n*n 3xTF32 batched GEMM (V^T V over the whole n-column basis). But V is assembled as [Vd | Vc] where BOTH blocks are independently CQR2-orthonormalized AND Vc is explicitly projected orthogonal to Vd (R -= Qd Qd^T R, twice). So V^T V is I by CONSTRUCTION up to: (a) within-Vd CQR2 residual, (b) within-Vc CQR2 residual, (c) the cross-block Vd^T Vc leakage (the reproj residual). STEP 1 (probe): measure, per low-rank shape, the three residual terms separately -- is the FULL orth dominated by the cross-block term (n*k*nc, MUCH smaller than n*n*n) while the within-block terms are always tiny (CQR2 guarantees ~1e-3)? If so, the gate can check ||Vd^T Vc||_1 (the cross term, cheap) + trust CQR2's within-block orthonormality, replacing the n^3 GEMM with an n*k*nc GEMM. CRITICAL SAFETY: the orth gate exists to catch the CQR2-FAILURE case (rankdef/nearrank Qd goes rank-deficient at exact-rank -> within-block orth blows up -> fallback, per brief-34/37). So a cheaper gate that trusts within-block CQR2 would MISS exactly the failures that matter -- UNLESS it also cheaply checks the within-block Gram diagonal or a per-block norm. Test whether a block-structured gate (cross-block full + within-block CHEAP diagonal/trace check) preserves the EXACT same bad-mask as the full V^T V gate across all 5 shapes + 6 reseeds each. If it can't match the full gate's fallback decisions (misses a rankdef CQR2 failure), REFUTE -- the full n^3 orth GEMM is irreducible. If it matches, measure the geomean win (the n^3->n*k*nc reduction on 5 shapes). PURE-TORCH (gate code; no nvcc) -- GPU-light, keeps the fleet balanced vs briefs 35/38 (both nvcc). Forks best 5c66a54b3; do NOT change the harness thresholds or the fallback mechanism, only the internal orth COMPUTATION; do NOT touch the megakernel/two-level/mixed-peel gates; no 'stream' substring; verify 39/39 (esp rankdef/nearrank test shapes 8/9/15 where CQR2 is stressed) + quiet re-bench beats 35401 (or refute).

STEP-1 probe: instrument gate to measure 3 block-residual terms of unsorted V=[Vd,Vc] + block-max-gate bad-mask vs full V^TV. FINDINGS: within-Vd dominates rankdef/nearrank CQR2 failures (shape8 r_dd=1.55e-2, shape10 r_dd=1.23e-2, both TRIP thr while r_cc/r_dc stay small); cross term r_dc is 2.6e-3..6.4e-3 (comparable to within-block, NOT negligible); block-MAX gate MISSES a real fallback on mixed512 psd subset (orth_full 5.00e-3>thr but max block term 3.39e-3<thr, disagree=1) -> L1 does NOT decompose as max-of-block-norms, cross terms add per-column. Metric probe-inflated.

STEP-1 corrected: EXACT block reconstruction of ||V^TV-I||_1 from 3 blocks (Gdd,Gcc,Gdc) via per-column sums, exploiting V^TV symmetry to skip the redundant Gcd=Gdc^T block (~20% fewer gate-GEMM flops). Gdc MUST be 3xTF32 (abs-sum rectifies rounding noise, plain TF32 inflates ~2.6e-3). DECISION-MATCH: disagree_exact=0 on ALL 5 low-rank shapes + both mixed subsets (reldiff<=2.3e-7); reproduces full gate bad-mask exactly incl mixed512 psd where block-max missed. Metric probe-inflated.

Block-exact orth gate (live): reconstruct ||V^TV-I||_1 from 3 blocks (Gdd,Gcc,Gdc) skipping the redundant Gcd=Gdc^T (~20% fewer gate-GEMM flops). SAFETY PROVEN: reseed sweep 6 seeds x 5 low-rank shapes + 2 mixed subsets = 42 runs, TOTAL disagree_exact=0 vs monolithic full gate (rankdef r_dd up to 1.93, catches all 20 rankdef+3 nearrank fallbacks; mixed512 psd caught where block-MAX misses; reldiff<=2.3e-7). 39/39 PASS. PERF A/B (3x quiet each): parent monolithic med 35591 vs block-exact med 35769 = +178us/+0.5% REGRESSION -- gate GEMMs are launch/latency-bound on B200, 9 small GEMMs+reductions cost more than the flops saved. REFUTES the n^3->n*k*nc cut as a win; the monolithic 3-GEMM gate is faster.

brief-40 (cheapen low-rank orth gate via V=[Vd,Vc] block structure): built + measured a full solution; REFUTED the n^3->n*k*nc cut as a speedup, with the safety fully proven.

WHAT I BUILT: _orth_blockexact reconstructs ||V^TV-I||_1 EXACTLY from the 3 blocks (Gdd kxk, Gcc ncxnc, Gdc kxnc), exploiting V^TV symmetry to skip the redundant Gcd=Gdc^T (~3*n*k*nc fewer flops, ~20% of the gate GEMM). _lowrank_eigh now returns the unsorted (Vd,Vc). All 3 blocks in 3xTF32 (Gdc MUST be 3xTF32: abs-sum rectifies rounding noise -> plain TF32 inflates orth ~2.6e-3, flips gates).

SAFETY (the brief's crux) -- PROVEN identical to the full gate: reseed sweep 6 seeds x 5 low-rank shapes (3/4/8/10/12) + both mixed512 subsets = 42 shape-runs, TOTAL disagree_exact=0. rankdef512 reseeds hit within-Vd r_dd up to 1.93 (orth up to 6.50), nearrank1024 r_dd up to 0.138 -- within-Vd catches ALL 20 rankdef + 3 nearrank fallbacks; mixed512 psd fallback caught where a block-MAX shortcut MISSES it (block-MAX disagreed 3x). reldiff vs monolithic <= 2.3e-7. 39/39 PASS.

PER-TERM breakdown (single bench seed): good shapes orth dominated by within-Vc (r_cc 3.4e-3..5.6e-3) + cross (r_dc 2.7e-3..6.4e-3), within-Vd tiny (6e-5..6e-4); rankdef/nearrank orth dominated by within-Vd (trips thr). So NO within-block term is skippable -- the exact reconstruction needs all 3 blocks = same #GEMMs class as monolithic.

PERF A/B (3x quiet each, identical conditions): parent monolithic 3-GEMM gate 35561/35591/35612 (med 35591) vs block-exact 9-GEMM 35741/35769/35785 (med 35769) = +178us/+0.5% REGRESSION, reproduced (final 35761). The gate GEMMs are small (k/nc-col, contraction n) and LAUNCH/latency-bound on B200 -- 9 small GEMMs + 4 reductions + 2 transposes cost more than the 20% flops saved. Profile brief-40-trial-3 confirms: gate tf32gemm now split into more, smaller instances.

STILL OPEN under this objective: (1) the monolithic 3-GEMM gate stays the faster formulation -- no exact reconstruction with <3 GEMMs exists; a true win would need a batched SYRK (compute only the upper triangle in ONE launch) which torch does not expose (cuBLAS syrk is not tensor-core batched here) -- a custom CUDA syrk is nvcc (off-brief for this pure-torch micro). (2) The gate is only a fraction of the low-rank path; the bigger low-rank terms in the profile are the FP32-SIMT CQR2 solves + Vd lift (simt_sgemm, the dominant time), not the gate -- a separate brief could attack those. (3) My change is orthogonal to brief-35's shape-4/10 cluster inner-solve win (gate is on the outer V, downstream) and could be dropped; recommend NOT stacking block-exact (it regresses). Parent 5c66a54b3's monolithic gate should be retained.
